content: बन्धः [बन्ध्-घञ्] .²1 A tie, bond (in general) (आशाबन्ध <ab>&c.</ab>). .²2 A hair-band, fillet; रतिविगलितबन्धे केशहस्ते सुकेश्याः (सति) <ls>V. 4. 22</ls>; <ls>Ś. 1. 29</ls>. .²3 A chain, fetter. .²4 Fettering, confining, imprisoning, confinement, imprisonment; बन्धं चानिच्छता घोरं त्वयासौ पुरुषर्षभ <ls>Rām. 5. 21. 19</ls>; अधार्मिकं त्रिभिर्न्यायैर्निगृह्णीयात् प्रयत्नतः . निरोधनेन बन्धेन विविधेन वधेन च .. <ls>Ms. 8. 310</ls>. .²5 Catching, capturing, catching hold of; गजबन्ध <ls>R. 16. 2</ls>. .²6 .³({%a%}) Forming, constructing, arranging; सर्गबन्धो महाकाव्यम् <ls>S. D. 6</ls>. .³({%b%}) Building, erecting. .²7 Feeling, conceiving, cherishing; हे राजानस्त्यजत सुकविप्रेमबन्धे विरोधम् <ls>Vikr. 18. 107</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 81</ls>. .²8 Connection, union, intercourse. .²9 Joining or folding together, combining; प्रासादवातायनदृश्यबन्धैः साकेतनार्योऽञ्जलिभिः प्रणेमुः <ls>R. 14. 13</ls>; अञ्जलिबन्धः <ab>&c.</ab> .²10 A bandage, ligature. .²11 Agreement, harmony. .²12 Manifestation, display, exhibition; मनसिजतरुपुष्पं रागबन्धप्रवालम् (यौवनम्) <ls>R. 18. 52</ls>. .²13 Bondage, confinement to this world (<ab>opp.</ab> मुक्ति which is ‘complete emancipation from the trammels of the world’); बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी <ls>Bg. 18. 30</ls>; बन्धोन्मुक्त्यै खलु मखमुखान् कुर्वते कर्मपाशान् <ls>Bv. 4. 21</ls>; <ls>R. 13. 58</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 7</ls>. .²14 Result, consequence. .²15 A position, posture in general; आसनबन्धधीरः <ls>R. 2. 6</ls>; पर्यङ्कबन्धस्थिरपूर्वकायम् <ls>Ku. 3. 45</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 3.">59</ls>. .²16 A particular position in sexual intercourse, or a particular mode of sexual enjoyment (these are said in Ratimañjarī to be 16, but other writers increase the number to 84). .²17 A border, frame-work. .²18 Arrangement of a stanza in a particular shape; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} खड्गबन्ध, पद्मबन्ध, मुरजबन्ध ({%vide%} <ls>K. P. 9</ls> {%ad loc.%}). .²19 A sinew, tendon. .²20 The body. .²21 A deposit, pledge. .²22 An embankment, throwing a bridge across (a river). .²23 A disease in which the eyelids cannot he wholly closed.
